1. Long-length accentuated force exercises create maximal torque while the prime movers are stretched (e.g., chest fly; a ).
2. Short-length accentuated force exercises create maximal torque while the prime movers are shortened (e.g., hip thrust; b ).
3. Midlength accentuated force exercises create maximal torque while the prime movers are between the extremes (e.g., 45 ° back extension; c ).
